serverInfo.name: Attesta
serverInfo.description: Provenance-grade Portugal residential property data and signed JWS verification for AI agents.

authentication.notes: Pass api_key tool parameter or X-API-Key header for Stripe-metered access (~200 free calls/month). Without a key, REST returns HTTP 402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED (x402 v2). Retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search deduplicated residential property listings in Portugal. Coverage: PT residential. Cost: €0.01 per call. Example: search_listings(region='PT-08', city='Faro', max_price_eur=300000, limit=10)

api_key.description: Optional Attesta API key for metered billing

tools.name: get_property
tools.description: Get canonical property record with sources, staleness score, and current price. Cost: €0.01 per call.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Get price_events timeline including price cuts and delistings. Cost: €0.02 per call.

tools.name: get_market_stats
tools.description: Aggregate market stats in envelope 1.0: median €/m² (p25/p75), inventory, stale_rate, median days on market. Cost: €0.02 per call.

tools.name: get_comps
tools.description: Comparable active listings by area_m2 ±tolerance; returns comps + median €/m² in envelope 1.0. Cost: €0.02 per call.

tools.name: check_listing_freshness
tools.description: Check if a property is fresh, stale, or likely phantom/delisted; includes staleness_components. Cost: €0.02 per call.

tools.name: verify_claim
tools.description: Verify a claim or listing URL; returns per-predicate verdicts and a signed JWS receipt (attesta/verify@0.2). Provide exactly one of claim or url.

url.description: Listing URL to observe and attest
